name: Mission: Red Planet (Second Edition)

rounds.endCondition: After round 10 and the final scoring phase

categories.label: Collected point tokens (total value)
categories.labelVi: Tổng giá trị token điểm đã thu
categories.hint: Sum the printed value of all point tokens won from production phases.

categories.label: Completed mission card points
categories.labelVi: Điểm thẻ nhiệm vụ hoàn thành
categories.hint: Reveal mission cards; add the printed value of each one completed (values are printed on the cards).

categories.label: Discovery card adjustments (+/-)
categories.labelVi: Điểm cộng/trừ từ thẻ khám phá
categories.hint: Add or subtract points from discovery cards that affect you; can be negative.

categories.label: Ice Monopoly (most ice tokens)
categories.labelVi: Độc quyền băng (nhiều token băng nhất)
categories.hint: Enter number of ice point tokens held. Most ice gets 9 pts; ties split the 9 rounded down.

categories.label: Number of point tokens (tiebreaker only)
categories.labelVi: Số lượng token điểm (chỉ để phá hòa)
categories.hint: Quantity of point tokens regardless of value; used only if scores tie.

tiebreakers.description: Largest quantity of point tokens regardless of value
If still tied, the tied players share the victory.

notes: family: majority-area-control. Points are earned in three production phases by area majority per Mars zone (not itemised; tracked by token values). Final scoring = mission cards + point tokens +/- discoveries; Ice Monopoly global mission is 9 pts. Two-player variant and Phobos/event specifics not modelled. Official FFG rulebook PDF could not be downloaded in this session; figures taken from a rules transcription (UltraBoardGames) only, so single-source.

sources.title: Mission: Red Planet rules (UltraBoardGames, transcribed from rulebook)
